title: Logical hash envelope v1
description: Closed domain-separated RFC 8785/SHA-256 preimage envelope. Hashers prefix the ASCII domain value to RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the entire envelope with the domain member omitted. Semantic validators additionally prove DAG stage ordering, references, ordinals, ranges, fragment/joiner cardinality, and payload-kind rank equality.
